title: Reassess ordinary food oatmeal against the colloidal-oatmeal exact grounding
body:
Oatmeal.yaml and the W04 supplied-form proposal retain NCIT:C29298 as exact identity. The NCIT term describes finely divided colloidal oatmeal, while the inspected JCM52/NBRC304 sources specify ordinary powdered Quaker oats and DSMZ425 describes food oatmeal. Powdered food alone does not establish the colloidal therapeutic material.

Exact reviewed scope:
- Finding `W04-BIO-HOLD-03`; stable key `w04-independent-W04-BIO-HOLD-03`; immutable peer review `20261108T070033Z-w04-successor-science-v1`.
- `I1201-BIO-P-oatmeal_supplied_form`; owner `data/ingredients/mapped/Oatmeal.yaml`; before `c1af211a9887f825f958c80ef5d147330b898f754fa0390eade836530d9b57b6`; proposed SHA256 `5e257436da0a05799c4ee4abd6ae7f59a6610382934909be2073181ff8942fcc`.
  [Exact published proposal](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-04/successors/issue-1201-v1/proposals/biological/Oatmeal.yaml).

Preserve the source-supported Quaker/powdered supplied-form facts. Review the owner’s complete authentic occurrence/history scope and select an appropriate identity and asymmetric grounding only when evidenced. Do not silently equate powder with colloidal grade, select a replacement ontology merely by a shared label, or merge another owner. Leave the exact grounding decision held if current evidence cannot settle it; preserve physical, role and export holds.

- [Primary/ontology source](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=304); capture SHA256 `fab243f6c64033ecf48f2974fd7d3bf878115b6977ac2f7bfd67b899a74f6578`; Exact retrieved response; requested source URL https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=304
- [Primary/ontology source](https://bacmedia.dsmz.de/pdf/425); capture SHA256 `9e1e98c598a7cec5584846a401073c4c4b889e17e2cfac5e7971c05b8b9fd916`; Exact retrieved response; requested source URL https://bacmedia.dsmz.de/pdf/425
